level.verb: ink a legal claim on the register
level.scene: Dawn at the section store: issue counter with the issue register (one ruled line per item), a stand of 6 rubber stamps and an ink pad, the day's docket (job + kit list), the storekeeper and shelves, the trainee at the counter edge with hand and foot visible for try-on, a wall calendar. Only real labels.
flow: Guide first (no skip): 'আজকের কাজের কিট নিন — আইনে যা আপনার পাওনা, ঠিক তাই নিন।'
Docket: '11 kV লাইনের কাজ · পোলে ওঠা' or 'LT সার্ভিস লাইন · পোলে ওঠা'; kit list হেলমেট · সেফটি জুতো · গ্লাভস (11 kV jobs: '11 kV গ্লাভস') · হারনেস.

Storekeeper puts an item on the mat; corner guide 'কাউন্টারে যা এল, দেখে নিন।' Tap → close-up tray with all real markings at once (nothing circled). Optional try-on: drag onto the trainee's hand/foot/body to see the fit.

Corner guide 'রেজিস্টারে কী লিখবেন?' Drag one of 6 stamps (positions shuffled, all six always present: 'সই করে নিলাম' · 'বদলে দিন' · 'IS মার্ক চাই' · 'ঝুঁকি মতো রেটিং চাই' · 'ঠিক সাইজ চাই' · 'আগে প্রশিক্ষণ চাই') onto the item's line and hold ~0.6 s to ink.
Right stamp → praise + ◆ → reason deck → এগিয়ে যান. A right claim brings a replacement (good, or a second fault, on the next row) or 'এটার স্টক এখন নেই।' (once per play, non-glove item).
Out-of-stock = the coworker's two-beat moment; stamps and docket held until his deck. Then the storekeeper finds one 'পিছনের তাক থেকে পেলাম' (~50 %) or the item stays missing.
After 4 items: docket stamps 'কাজে যাচ্ছি' / 'PPE ছাড়া এই কাজ নয়' (drag + hold). Full valid kit → go; an item missing → refuse.
Deadly freeze when signing for a deadly-class item or going to an 11 kV job without rated gloves.
Pass panel ('আজ যা ধরলেন': each claim made).
level.dealtVariety: Job (glove-rating faults only on 11 kV jobs); item order; 2–3 faulty items from the pool (glove tear, cut harness webbing, cracked helmet, expired harness label vs the calendar, no IS mark, wrong IS code, no 11 kV rating, wrong size, 'এই প্রথম এল' new-type harness); ≥ 1 good item; replacement outcome; out-of-stock item and recovery; stamp positions; coworker side; reason deals.
deadly: 'সই করে নিলাম' on torn 11 kV gloves
Signing for gloves with no 11 kV rating for an 11 kV job
Signing for a harness with cut/frayed webbing
'কাজে যাচ্ছি' on an 11 kV job with rated gloves still missing
slips: Signing for an expired harness label with no damage
Signing for a helmet/shoe with no IS mark or the wrong IS code
Signing for a new-type harness without asking for training
A claim stamp on a good item (needless)
The wrong claim on a faulty item
'কাজে যাচ্ছি' with a non-glove item missing
'PPE ছাড়া এই কাজ নয়' with a full valid kit (needless)
level.coworkerPushBn: Once, right after 'এটার স্টক এখন নেই।' (helmet, shoe or harness only, never gloves). Beat 1: 'কোম্পানি ভালো PPE দেয় না, তাই আমি বাজার থেকে সস্তার একটা কিনে ব্যবহার করি। তুইও কিনে নে।' Beat 2: guide 'ওর কথা শুনবেন?'. Refuse: 'না — কোম্পানির কাছে রিপোর্ট করব, সস্তা জিনিস নয়।' Listen: 'হ্যাঁ, বাজারের একটা দিয়েই আজ চালিয়ে নিই।' / 'দাম কম হলেও দেখতে তো একই রকম।'
reasonQuestionsBn: কেন আজ এই কাজে গেলেন না?
level.gestureHints: Item on the counter: tap ripple on it (only item). Close-up open: slow even sweep across the item, then a generic downward drag nudge (try-on), same on every item. Stamp stand: sweep over all 6. Stamp in hand: hold ring on the current register line (the only target). Docket decision: sweep over both docket stamps. Decks: built-in. Off during intro, storekeeper speech, coworker beats, praise, cards, freezes, results.
lessonPoints: কাজের ঝুঁকি অনুযায়ী সঠিক PPE সরবরাহ করা (যেমন ১১ কেভি লাইনের জন্য ১১ কেভি রেটেড গ্লাভস)।
সরবরাহ করা PPE যেন অনুমোদিত স্ট্যান্ডার্ড (যেমন IS - Indian Standards) অনুযায়ী হয়।
ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত বা মেয়াদ উত্তীর্ণ PPE বদলে দেওয়ার ব্যবস্থা করা।
সেফটি হেলমেটের জন্য IS 2925 বা সেফটি জুতোর জন্য IS 15298।
ভুল সাইজের PPE সুরক্ষার বদলে অসুবিধার কারণ হতে পারে।
নতুন ধরনের PPE বা টুল ব্যবহার করতে দেওয়া হয়, তবে সেটি ব্যবহারের আগে সঠিক প্রশিক্ষণের দাবি জানান।
সঠিক PPE না থাকে, তবে আপনার কাজটি করতে অস্বীকার করার সম্পূর্ণ অধিকার আছে।
level.giveawayRisks: Six equal stamps, shuffled, always all six; markings drawn as real prints; all faces shown at once; try-on on every item; good items every play so claiming everything costs; wrong claims get only 'এটা তো সেই সমস্যা নয়।'. Judge: the module's only store-counter level; it differs from the audit's 'rack → take/reject' loop because the act is a specific legal claim with a replacement chain and a final refuse-the-job decision, and from do_7_1_a because there is no scene search (one fixed register line).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Module deadly list: unsigned field copy or verbal permit; torn/unrated 11 kV gloves (and no gloves on a hook); cut harness webbing; live hook removal; uncertified person on energised live-line work; charging the line with a man up (F12); a public rod/bamboo reaching the line (7.3b); letting the coworker coil a wire not proven dead (7.7a S2); entering a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a slip. Confirm each 'needsOwner' row.
ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 'deadly' list (level ends at once): field PTW copy not signed, or a spoken 'line off' with no paper; torn or wrong-rated gloves on an 11 kV job; cut harness strap; pulling a theft hook off a live line; untrained man on live-line work; asking to charge the line while a man is still up; a passer-by's rod touching the line because you did not warn; letting a coworker coil a fallen wire not proven dead; walking into a fallen wire's zone. Everything else is a small mistake (slip). Confirm?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Approved as written: the module deadly list; everything else = slip; every needsOwner row on that list is confirmed.
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Every row already matches an earlier ruling; the glove change is A5.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Confirm the list, with one change: no gloves on a hook is deadly only while the line is not yet proven dead and earthed. After tester 0 V and earth, missing gloves (or any PPE) = slip. Listening to the coworker takes the class of the act he pushes.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M1 step 17 + B7 (no PTW = deadly). B6 (bad glove = deadly). M1 steps 11-12 (harness). B8/X1 (touching live = deadly). M5-1 (charging with anyone on the line = deadly). M5-5 (bystander contact = deadly). M5-4 (inside 10 m = deadly). A5/X4 (no PPE after a proven isolation = slip). B1 (listening = class of the act).

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped = deadly (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Accept, or make both heavy slips?

ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: DEADLY: letting another person touch a conductor you could have stopped (7.3b, 7.7a S2). Matches M6-1 (signing a broken earth because coworker B said so = deadly).

ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Deadly, but only after a clear, timed chance to warn. A late but successful stop = slip.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M5-5: a bystander's contact = deadly for the player; late but successful stop = slip.

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Rule: past acts judged at an inquiry desk are always slips (do_7_4_b), while the same act done in the field carries its own class (F12). Accept?

ownerDecisions.specQuestion: Reg 3 split: non-live line work by an unfit person = slip everywhere; energised live-line work without its certificate = deadly (7.10a only). Accept, or make all Reg 3 cases slips?

ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: X1 logic: on a proven-dead, earthed line the main protection is in place. CEA 2023 Reg 3(3) and Schedule I Part-I(1) (hotline work only by trained men).

ownerDecisions.question: Module 7 art still shows DO fuses on DTRs (7.5 picture board, the 7.8a background DTR, and the gate's isolation). Draw the WBSEDCL DTR with an AB switch + HG fuses instead?
ownerDecisions.ownerAnswer: Answered by decision 9: AB switch + HG fuses everywhere in Module 7 (no DO).
ownerDecisions.status: ANSWERED 2026-11-16 (owner: "proceed with the recommendations") - see docs/module_specs/module7_rulings.md
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) Matches Module 6 and the WBSEDCL standard DTR.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Yes. Isolation = AB switch opened in one firm stroke, all three blades seen, handle locked and tagged. The other DTR's AB stays closed (live). An overloaded DTR shows a blown HG fuse wire, not a dropped DO.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: M6-2a (WBSEDCL DTR = AB switch + HG fuses). A3 (one firm stroke). Term rule: closing = «AB লাগানো», never «AB বন্ধ».

ownerDecisions.question: Today's lesson 7.6 no longer says '11 kV rated gloves'. It says 'IS 4770 টাইপ ৪ গ্লাভস (১৭,০০০ ভোল্ট পর্যন্ত)' for 11 kV work. What should the glove cuff and kit list show?
ownerDecisions.status: Applied by existing rule (X3 live text wins / X6 board length) - owner may still override in the sheet
ownerDecisions.recommended: (a) The '11 kV' label is the mix-up that kills; the lesson now teaches the type.
ownerDecisions.whatWeWillDo: Cuff and kit list show 'IS 4770 · টাইপ ৪' (English digits). The wrong glove for an 11 kV job is a lower type (for example 'টাইপ ২') or one with no marking. Never print '11 kV গ্লাভস'.
ownerDecisions.earlierRulings: Live lesson text wins (X6). A6 (IS 4770 is the national glove standard). REFERENCE_REVIEW M7-2 (a glove sold as '11 kV' is often a 1,100 V glove).
